candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's call to payment (/v1/authorizations) times out (ReadTimeout, transport error), propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency cause (resource saturation vs network) not established; no payment service telemetry admitted.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing with 502 driven by a transport ReadTimeout on order->payment /v1/authorizations, while inventory/redis succeed. Metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2.4s. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency causing order timeouts.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/resource metrics to confirm payment-side slowness as the timeout origin
Payment service logs or traces for the /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout
